statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect intermittent rhythm disturbances that may contribute to cerebrovascular risk
The supplied clinical indication note documents inadequate diagnostic yield from prior standard monitoring modalities
The denial reason code is CO-197
